reviews.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。
reviews.summary: 反复出现的是 C01 浏览器验收，但每轮根因不同：实时准备被当成登录硬门槛、Tickets 列表崩溃、子路由缺 Outlet、 mutation 后列表缓存不失效；其中只有缓存一致性暴露出明确的 API 指引矛盾，其余多为应用偏离或应用实现问题，不能据此认定 NocoBase3 框架缺陷。第 5 轮 build/test 又暴露迁移对授权插件 Collection 的依赖，应用最终用 hasCollection 守卫绕开；工厂在 5 次修复后按 task-budget 停止，符合资源上限，但不应把不同指纹的失败合并成一次框架故障。

modules.name: 实时连接与会话准备边界
modules.scope: 认证 Provider 如何在实时连接未就绪时暴露 preparation 状态，以及应用外壳是否把实时当成本地会话的前置条件。
modules.limitations: @nocobase/realtime 客户端源码不在捕获奖 packages 中，无法核对“未构造 WebSocket”与重连恢复的实现；只评审 auth-provider 的契约、shell 指引和 QA 事件。

requirements.need: 已登录用户即使实时 socket 未建立，也应能进入应用并使用 HTTP 会话；恢复连接后再补上权限失效与通知刷新。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责暴露可等待、可失败的 preparation 状态与重试入口；应用负责不要把实时连接当作渲染已认证 shell 的硬条件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 useAuthentication() 的 preparation/retryPreparation，并给等待设上限，超时继续 HTTP；认证 Skill 目前只列 session/isPending/refresh。
requirements.actualUsage: 认证 Provider 已有 failed/retry，但 Skill 未记载，初始应用把 preparation 失败渲染成阻塞页；修复后应用改为 3 秒 grace 并继续。日志还显示应用未构造 socket，而手工 WS 可打开。

requirements.need: 实时连接断开或无法建立时，客户端应能在后台恢复，不应要求用户重新登录。
requirements.responsibility: 框架的 realtime client 负责重连/恢复；应用只负责监督与可见性策略。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 未确认；@nocobase/realtime/client 实现未包含在冻结 packages 中。
requirements.actualUsage: 日志只能确认应用没有建立 WS、手工 WS 成功；应用最终另加 realtime-watchdog，无法判断上游 client 是否本应恢复。

requirementFit.reason: Provider 暴露 preparing/failed/retry，能力上足以让应用做有界等待；但 Skill 未记载这些状态，框架也没有内建“失败后继续”策略，初始应用仍被 10 秒失败态挡住。

usability.reason: preparation 与 retry API 简单一致，但默认等待 10 秒且失败后页面自行决定，应用需要额外 grace/watchdog 才能避免全局阻塞。

agentFriendliness.reason: 实现类型暴露 preparation/retry，足以写对有界等待；但认证 Skill 只列 session/isPending/refresh，Agent 很难从文档发现失败态与重试，实时 client 的恢复也没有可读源码。

design.reason: 实现把认证 HTTP 会话与实时准备分开建模，preparation 只是状态而非异常，retry 作为显式动作；不足是这层设计没有写进认证 Skill 的契约。

reliability.reason: 实现确实在 onOpen 未到达时定时发布 failed，并支持 retry；但失败态没有自动回退，实际由应用侧 grace/watchdog 兜底，且恢复实现无法核对。

modules.name: 客户端路由与嵌套子页面
modules.scope: 父/子路由声明、路径拼接、Outlet 渲染责任和子页面呈现方式。
modules.limitations: 只核对了路由注册实现与 child-routes 指引；未逐一运行各布局的路由测试。

requirements.need: 工单列表、新建页与工单详情应各有独立 URL，直接打开/刷新仍显示对应页面。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 children 路由注册、路径拼接和校验；应用负责在父页放 <Outlet /> 并按呈现方式返回 RouteChildPage/Dialog/Drawer。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 client/routes.ts 的 children 声明子路由，父页面在内容区渲染 <Outlet />，覆盖式页面用 RouteChildPage。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用把子路由声明在 children，但父页漏了 <Outlet />，verify-4 中 /new 与 /:id 静默退回列表；最终补上 Outlet。

requirementFit.reason: 路由注册实现支持 children、相对路径拼接和错误校验，指引也完整给出父页 Outlet 责任；本次失败是应用漏渲染 Outlet，不是能力缺失。

usability.reason: 路由字段与路径规则一致，缺少 path、保留路径和冲突都会给出明确错误；静默退回列表来自应用页面，而非路由库。

agentFriendliness.reason: child-routes.md 用加粗规则明确“父页面必须自己放 Outlet”，并列出 RouteChildPage/Dialog/Drawer 的呈现选择，足以让 Agent 发现正确入口。

design.reason: 路由声明集中在 routes.ts，页面组件只决定内容呈现方式，父子边界与覆盖层职责分离。

reliability.reason: 实现会拼接父子路径并拒绝缺失/保留/冲突路径；实际故障可由应用补一个 Outlet 解决，说明路由契约本身兑现。

modules.name: 数据读取、缓存失效与站内通知
modules.scope: 应用如何通过统一 API client 读取数据，以及 mutation 后如何让列表/计数等共享查询保持一致；站内通知 hook 作为已实现的缓存失效范例。
modules.limitations: 未评审 Refine/TanStack Query 的完整集成，也未覆盖所有列表页；只对照 API 指引、通知 hook 与工单列表实现。

requirements.need: 创建或分派工单成功后，返回列表应立即看到新状态，不需要整页刷新。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责提供统一 API client 和可复用的缓存失效模式；应用负责在 mutation 成功后失效相关查询键。
requirements.recommendedUsage: api.md 要求 useApiClient；但只说要自己写加载逻辑，没有给出 mutation→invalidate 的跨页面做法，通知 hook 则内部使用 invalidateQueries。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用自写 useTicketsApi，只用组件内 revision 重取；创建/分派后列表保持旧数据，verify-6 记录必须整页刷新。

requirementFit.reason: 统一 API client 足以完成请求，通知插件也示范了 mutation 后失效；但框架没有为业务列表提供共享缓存契约，本需求的实际一致性只能靠应用自行补。

usability.reason: 每个页面都要手写 loading/error/reload；api.md 又劝阻 TanStack Query，却没有给出等效的跨页失效步骤，接入成本高且容易漏。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引把 Refine hooks 与 TanStack Query 混在一起劝阻，而通知 hook 自己使用 QueryClient/invalidateQueries；Agent 难以从文档判断该用哪种缓存并正确失效。

design.reason: API client 与通知插件边界清楚，通知用 query key 统一失效是良好抽象；不足是业务页面缺少同级的共享查询失效约定。

reliability.reason: 通知 hook 在 mutation settle 后 invalidate 并支持回滚，兑现一致性；工单列表没有失效路径，实际产生陈旧结果，说明框架层未兜住这类用法。

modules.name: 授权快照与记录级范围
modules.scope: 角色/记录级权限的服务端判定与客户端可见性检查，重点看工程师是否只能看到分派给自己的工单。
modules.limitations: 未逐条核对工单路由的过滤条件实现；只评审授权 API、快照契约及 QA 中角色隔离结果。

requirements.need: 员工只看自己的工单，工程师只处理分派给自己的工单，服务台看全部；客户端不得显示服务端会拒绝的记录。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责权限快照、can() 与记录级 access 条件；应用负责在列表/详情查询中应用正确的 record scope。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 服务端用 record access/条件收窄查询，客户端用 useCan 检查 (type,id,action)，并根据权限 revision 刷新。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用 useCan 与角色路由；verify-4 中工程师仍看到未分派工单，说明应用查询范围有漏，修复后 verify-6 角色隔离通过。

requirementFit.reason: 授权库提供记录级 access 与权限快照，useCan 提供客户端检查，足以表达本需求的角色隔离；本次泄漏来自应用查询范围，而非授权 API 缺失。

usability.reason: useCan 的 resource/action 形状直接，返回 can/isPending/error/retry；但调用方必须自己保证 resource id 与 revision 正确，列表过滤仍需服务端条件配合。

agentFriendliness.reason: 客户端 hook 与快照语义清楚，失败时 can 为 false 并给出 error/retry；本模块没有对应的分步业务指引，Agent 仍需自行把 record scope 落到每个查询。

design.reason: 服务端记录访问注册表、权限快照和客户端可见性检查分层明确，快照只列出允许的三元组，避免前后端各算一套。

reliability.reason: 快照与记录访问实现把授权结果收敛为服务端条件/允许集合，客户端检查失败时 fail-closed；修复后角色隔离通过。

modules.name: 数据库迁移与嵌入式测试装配
modules.scope: 迁移如何在不安装授权插件的嵌入式测试 app 中运行，以及迁移误用插件 Collection 时的失败边界。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖 verify-3 与 verify-5 的完整构建脚本；只核对迁移器实现、任务容器、Skill 规则和 verify-5 失败堆栈。

requirements.need: 应用迁移不应假定授权插件 Collections 一定存在；嵌入式测试只装最小插件集时也应能启动或明确跳过。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责确定性的迁移执行与隔离的任务容器；应用负责迁移自包含，并对可选插件 Collection 做存在性判断。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移用 builder/query 表达自身 schema；若必须用 repository 访问插件 Collection，先做存在性检查并把前提写清。
requirements.actualUsage: verify-5 中迁移直接 repository(authorizationPermissionSets)，测试 app 未注册授权插件而 COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND；最终迁移加 hasCollection 守卫。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移器能按历史/checksum 执行并在失败时停止，任务容器也刻意隔离应用服务；缺口在指引没有提醒嵌入式测试的最小插件集，导致应用迁移把插件集合当必然存在。

usability.reason: 迁移 API 与错误信息清楚（COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND 直接指出集合），但修复需要应用自己加存在性判断；框架没有提供“可选集合”助手。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 已警告 repository 是在押注未声明的 Collection 形状，却没说明测试 app 可能不安装插件集合，Agent 在 verify-5 才通过失败堆栈发现。

design.reason: 迁移上下文用冻结 task container，迁移器集中处理历史、锁、checksum 与 pending 选择，边界和职责清楚。

reliability.reason: 迁移器按批执行、校验历史并停止于失败；任务容器阻止误用应用级 manager。实际失败是应用前置条件缺失，最终用 hasCollection 守卫解决。

findings.title: 实时准备失败被应用当成登录硬门槛，导致全员停在 Unable to connect
findings.detail: verify-1 中登录和 get-session 成功，但应用没有构造 /main/ws，页面停留在“Unable to connect”。认证 Provider 在 10 秒后发布 failed，并暴露 retryPreparation，但认证 Skill 只描述 session/isPending/refresh，没有给出准备失败后的回退契约；初始应用因此把 failed 渲染成阻塞页。
findings.impact: 所有角色无法进入业务页面，C01 完全不可测；这是本轮修复链的第一处停点。
findings.suggestedChange: 应用采用 3 秒 grace：超时后 invalidate 授权快照并进入 HTTP 会话；同时把 preparation/retryPreparation 的官方回退规则补进认证 Skill。

diagnosis.trigger: 已登录会话下实时 socket 未能建立，preparation 在 10 秒后变为 failed
diagnosis.expected: 已认证 shell 继续使用 HTTP 会话，实时恢复后再补通知/权限刷新
diagnosis.actual: 应用渲染阻塞式 Unable to connect，重试/重登均不能进入
diagnosis.workaround: 应用把等待限制为 3 秒并在超时后继续，同时增加 realtime watchdog
diagnosis.acceptance: 阻断 /main/ws 时登录仍进入应用；恢复 socket 后通知与权限失效自动恢复，不需要重新登录

findings.title: Tickets 父页缺少 Outlet，新建与详情路由静默退回列表
findings.detail: verify-4 中 /main/tickets/new 与 /main/tickets/:id 都只显示列表。路由库已按 children 注册子路径，child-routes 指引第 11 行明确父页面必须自己渲染 <Outlet />；最终 Tickets 页面补上 Outlet 后子路由恢复。
findings.impact: 用户无法创建、分派或处理工单，C01 的关键操作全部不可达。
findings.suggestedChange: 保留父页 Outlet，并让路由测试覆盖直接打开 /new 与 /:id 的断言；可考虑在开发模式下对空 Outlet 给出警告。

diagnosis.expected: 子路由内容渲染在父页内容区
diagnosis.actual: 父页没有 Outlet，两个 URL 都只显示列表
diagnosis.workaround: 在 Tickets 父页 PageContainer 内补 <Outlet />
diagnosis.acceptance: 新建/详情 URL 分别出现表单与详情；刷新、直接打开和浏览器返回均保持对应页面

findings.title: API 指引劝阻 TanStack Query，却没有给出跨页面缓存失效方案
findings.detail: api.md 第 235 行说没有共享数据加载 hook，并让读者不要使用 Refine 数据 hooks 或 TanStack Query；但框架自己的站内通知 hook 就使用 QueryClient，并在 mutation 后 invalidateQueries。应用因此手写 useTicketsApi，只维护组件内 revision，verify-6 中创建/分派后列表保持旧数据。
findings.impact: 照指引实现会得到无共享失效的本地状态，产生静默陈旧列表；用户可能重复分派或误判工单状态。
findings.suggestedChange: 修正“不要用 TanStack Query”的一刀切表述，明确哪些场景由应用自管缓存；在 api.md 增加 mutation 成功后 invalidateQueries 的跨页面示例，或提供 app-client 级统一失效入口。
findings.claimed: api.md：没有共享数据加载 hook，使用 useApiClient+useEffect；不要使用 Refine 的 useList/useTable/useForm 或 TanStack Query。
findings.observed: notification-in-app 的 useInboxActions 使用 useQueryClient 并在 onSettled 调用 invalidateQueries；应用也自建 QueryClient。按指引手写的工单列表没有失效路径，verify-6 记录必须整页刷新。

diagnosis.trigger: 创建或分派工单成功并返回列表
diagnosis.expected: 共享查询缓存被失效，列表显示最新记录
diagnosis.actual: useTicketsApi 只重取本地 revision，列表保持旧数据直到整页刷新
diagnosis.workaround: 用户整页刷新；应用可自行引入 QueryClient 并手动失效
diagnosis.acceptance: 创建/分派成功后列表无需刷新出现新记录；文档示例能在两个页面间验证失效，通知 hook 与业务列表使用一致的缓存约定

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Fixed the helpdesk sign-in lockout by making realtime readiness a bounded wait instead of a requirement for authenticated HTTP routes, and by supervising and guarding the realtime connection so a failed socket attempt cannot unmount the application. Also made format:check ignore the locally generated config.yml, which the factory excludes from its own auto-formatting but not from the application's Prettier ignore file. This round repaired the ticket child routes, made the engineer queue assignment-only, restored requester close/reopen, and installed the demo from a sample seed during the factory's separate test installation. A fresh test apply now contains the five demo accounts, their jobs, and eight demo tickets in every desk state; a production apply contains only the administrator and no tickets. A production build/API pass also caught that reopen with a reason failed because the lifecycle declared an accepted field the ticket table did not have; that was fixed and re-verified through the real endpoint. This round fixed the app-server verification failure: the requester close/reopen grant migration now skips when the authorization plugin's permission-set Collections are not registered, instead of failing the whole migration run.

blockers.title: Sign-in succeeded but every authenticated route stayed behind realtime preparation
blockers.symptom: After a successful username sign-in and a valid get-session response, the page stayed on 'Preparing your session…' and then showed 'Unable to connect' with Retry and Sign out. Retry, reload, and reopening the session repeated it; no new /main/ws WebSocket was constructed, while a manually opened socket succeeded.
blockers.rootCause: The signed-in shell treated an opened realtime socket as a prerequisite for mounting any authenticated route. The realtime client has no recovery when a reconnect attempt does not reach `new WebSocket` (an early return or a constructor failure), so the authentication provider's preparation stayed preparing until its ten-second timeout and then blocked the whole application behind the failure screen. Realtime is optional for authorization, which is fetched over HTTP and invalidated on session changes.
blockers.resolution: Bound session preparation to three seconds in client/routing/session-preparation.tsx; on expiry it invalidates the authorization snapshot and mounts the application while the realtime client keeps trying. Added client/lib/realtime-watchdog.ts: DefaultClientServiceProvider guards `reconnect()` so a throwing constructor cannot escape the authentication effect, and a watchdog forces a fresh connection every five seconds while subscriptions are active, the socket is closed, the tab is visible, and the browser is online. Updated the shell rule and the session-preparation tests to describe and verify the HTTP fallback.

blockers.title: The verifier's exact socket-construction failure could not be reproduced locally
blockers.symptom: Normal sign-in and reload against the same production server and database opened /main/ws and reached the business UI; the original failing browser state was not available for inspection.
blockers.rootCause: The failure depended on an environment or browser state in which the realtime client's reconnect path returned without constructing a WebSocket or threw during construction. The application code had no diagnostic or recovery path for that state, so the exact trigger could not be observed from source alone.
blockers.resolution: Covered both observable failure shapes with deterministic tests: a never-opening WebSocket and a throwing WebSocket constructor. Verified both in the production build at http://127.0.0.1:13000/main, including that the throwing constructor no longer blanks the page and that restoring a working constructor lets the watchdog open /main/ws.

blockers.title: format:check failed on the locally generated config.yml
blockers.symptom: `pnpm format:check` exited 1 with `[warn] config.yml` and `Code style issues found in the above file`.
blockers.rootCause: `pnpm nocobase config init` writes config.yml with a generated secrets key in double quotes, and deployment writes its own copy. The file is local configuration the factory owns and explicitly excludes from its `format:auto` stage, and `.gitignore` un-ignores it, so Prettier 3 checked it even though the application must not reformat or edit it.
blockers.resolution: Added `config.yml` to `.prettierignore` with a comment explaining that it is generated local configuration and that the factory already skips it when auto-formatting. The file itself was left untouched. `pnpm format:check '!.github/**'` now passes.

blockers.title: Ticket create and detail pages never appeared under the list route
blockers.symptom: Clicking a ticket or the create action changed the URL but the list stayed visible; the new-ticket form and ticket detail could not be reached, and the QA pass reported that employees could not submit tickets or service desk could not process them.
blockers.rootCause: client/pages/tickets/index.tsx was declared as the parent route but rendered no <Outlet />, so react-router had nowhere to mount /tickets/new and /tickets/:ticketId. The child pages also used a bare PageContainer instead of RouteChildPage, which would have stacked them below the parent rather than covering it.
blockers.resolution: Added <Outlet /> to the parent ticket list container and wrapped every create/detail return path in RouteChildPage. Added tests/components/tickets-routes.test.tsx and browser-verified the covering form/detail layers for Alice, Bob, and Dana.

blockers.title: Engineers could read unassigned pending tickets outside their queue
blockers.symptom: The support-engineer ticket scope exposed unassigned pending tickets in addition to tickets assigned to the engineer, so the queue and dashboard did not match the stated visibility rule.
blockers.rootCause: helpdesk.engineerTickets in server/tickets/resources.ts combined an assignee condition with anyScope/allScopes, allowing unassigned pending rows through the same repository policy used by the list and dashboard.
blockers.resolution: Changed the scope to a single assigneeId = current principal condition and removed the unassigned/all-scope branches. The engineer queue copy now says it shows only tickets assigned to me. Existing lifecycle tests and the Bob API/browser checks confirm only assigned tickets are visible.

blockers.title: Requesters could not close a resolved ticket or reopen a closed one
blockers.symptom: Employees could read their own tickets but lacked the close and reopen actions required by the confirmation flow; service desk also lacked close by design, leaving a resolved ticket without a requester confirmation path.
blockers.rootCause: The employee permission seed and lifecycle guards only granted the employee read/create/comment/attach actions. Reopen was guarded by a service-desk role and close by an administrator role, neither of which matched the requester-owned confirmation flow.
blockers.resolution: Added close and reopen to the employee permission set with the own-ticket scope; introduced requesterClose and requesterReopen lifecycle guards; updated the client/server locale keys; added migration 202610200001_grant_requester_close_reopen for existing installs; and added lifecycle tests for requester success and non-requester rejection.

blockers.title: A fresh factory test install had no sample accounts or tickets
blockers.symptom: The QA browser saw only the Super Admin and an empty Tickets list even though the task requested sample data. A fresh NODE_ENV=test db apply created one user and zero tickets.
blockers.rootCause: The factory installs the database with NODE_ENV=test, then starts the application with NODE_ENV=production. The helpdesk demo was registered only on sampleDataToken, which runs during application start; it never ran in the pre-apply process, and the later production start treated the database as already installed. A seed cannot resolve application services because the database task container deliberately exposes only repository/query access.
blockers.resolution: Added sample seed database/main/seeds/202610200002_helpdesk_demo_data.ts, marked sample: true and guarded against production. It writes stable-id demo users, credential accounts, job assignments, and eight tickets in pending/processing/escalated/resolved/closed/cancelled states directly through the seed repository. The sampleDataToken provider still enriches the same ticket titles through the lifecycle on a direct development start. Added tests/logic/helpdesk-sample-seed.test.ts for idempotency, password verification, and the production guard. Verified a fresh NODE_ENV=test apply contains 5 demo users, 8 assignments, and 8 tickets, while a NODE_ENV=production apply contains only the administrator and no tickets.

blockers.title: Executed permission seed no longer matches its edited source checksum
blockers.symptom: db apply on the existing development database prints: Executed seed "202610070001_helpdesk_permission_sets" no longer matches its source.
blockers.rootCause: The employee grant was corrected in the seed source after that seed had already been executed on storage/database.sqlite. NocoBase records the source checksum and requires an explicit repair to accept the edit.
blockers.resolution: Kept the corrected immutable-style seed source and documented the warning. Did not run db repair --force because the task forbids bypassing the confirmation; fresh installs, including the factory verification database, execute the corrected seed without a warning.

blockers.title: Reopen failed through the real API when it carried a reason
blockers.symptom: The lifecycle unit test accepted reopen with a reason, but POST /api/tickets/:id/fire with transition reopen returned 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION: Field "reason" does not exist. The closed ticket stayed closed.
blockers.rootCause: The reopen transition declared accept: ["reason"]. @nocobase/lifecycle copies accepted input into the record update, and the tickets table has no reason column. The in-memory lifecycle test kit did not persist the accepted field, so it could not expose the mismatch.
blockers.resolution: Removed reason from the transition accept list. The reason remains in the transition input and audit history, which is where the lifecycle stores it. Added a definition assertion to tests/logic/helpdesk.test.ts, rebuilt the production server, and verified Bob receives 404 for reopen while Alice receives 200 and the ticket returns to pending with its assignee and close timestamps cleared.

blockers.title: Database migrations failed on an embedded app that registered no plugins
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime failed with AppDatabaseTaskError: Database migrations failed for connection "main": Collection "authorizationPermissionSets" does not exist, raised from 202610200001_grant_requester_close_reopen.
blockers.rootCause: The migration unconditionally resolved authorizationPermissionSets through context.repository, but that Collection belongs to the authorization plugin. The failing test boots an embedded scope with defineServerPlugins([]) plus one test plugin, so the plugin never registers its Collections and the repository guard threw COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND before the test could check its providers and route.
blockers.resolution: Guarded both up and down with context.builder.hasCollection('authorizationPermissionSets') and returned without writing when the Collection is absent; the builder lookup resolves installed metadata records, so a real installation still receives the grants even when plugins are not loaded during a CLI apply. Added tests/logic/helpdesk-grant-migration.test.ts covering the absent-Collection skip, the append of reopen/close while preserving other grants, the rollback removal, and the already-granted no-op. Re-ran app-server.test.ts, helpdesk.test.ts, the new test, the server typecheck, and ESLint/Prettier on the changed files.

improvements.title: Keep generated local configuration out of the Prettier check
improvements.detail: The factory's format:auto deliberately skips config.yml because it is generated and factory-owned, but the subsequent format:check had no matching ignore, so a generated file could fail a task independently of application code.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add config.yml to .prettierignore whenever an application keeps a generated config.yml in its workspace.

improvements.title: Verify sample data on the factory fresh-install path, not only on the existing database
improvements.detail: The existing development database already had samples from an earlier application start, which hid the fact that a fresh db apply produced only the administrator. The QA acceptance report exposed the gap.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run a temp-config NODE_ENV=test db apply and assert the expected sample users/tickets before considering sample data delivered.

An existing application may still use the `logic/` and `components/` layout below; follow its current conventions instead of moving unrelated tests. | What the test exercises                                   | Helper                                                       | Isolation and cleanup                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Repositories and transactions without application startup | `createDatabaseTest()` from `/server`                        | `isolation: 'schema'` resets and migrates before each case; the fixture destroys connections and drops its databases |
| A migration's schema and rollback                         | `describeMigration()` from `/server`                         | Owns its database and checks apply → rollback → reapply; `up` assertions run twice                                   |
| Routes, providers, plugins and authentication             | `createAppTest()` from `/server`                             | Default `scope: 'file'` shares an application; `scope: 'test'` installs a fresh one per case; cleanup is automatic   |
| A manually started test application                       | `createTestApp()` from `/server`                             | The caller closes it in `finally` with `await testApp.close()`                                                       |
| Components using application services                     | `renderWithApp()` from `/client`                             | Call inside a test; client shutdown is automatic and the React preset cleans up the DOM                              |
| A command operating on files or flags                     | `bindAppCommand()` + `runAppCommand()` from `/cli`           | The test owns its temporary files; command output capture is process-wide                                            |

An omitted connection keeps the application's configuration. Keep provisioned connection locations intact; use test configuration overrides for auth, seeds or other settings. Pure repository tests take explicit migration and seed sources; application fixtures install the application's registered sources by default.

Run database and server suites sequentially. CLI stream capture and environment stubs are process-wide, so do not use concurrent command cases. Keep temporary storage under the fixture's ownership, and never clean up a shared development database or a running Vite cache.

After creating the files in the linked examples, run from the application root:

```bash
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.database.config.ts
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.server.config.ts
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.client.config.ts
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.cli.config.ts
```

Run these commands one at a time. With all four groups copied, expect five database tests (including the migration), five server tests, five client tests and eight CLI tests (six file-command cases and two database-backed cases). A copied subset has the corresponding smaller count. The sample configurations set `passWithNoTests: false`; when using an existing configuration, still confirm that the named files ran.

If startup fails, check the installed package exports, the selected driver, the fixture's migration sources and the application's registered plugins before replacing a real service with a mock. A missing collection in a repository test usually needs its migration sources; failed sign-in needs the configured test seed and trusted origin; a server `403` with a valid session needs the intended grants. Client translation failures need the real namespace and locale keys, and CLI JSON failures need assertions on `exitCode` and the JSON error envelope.

```text
tests/logic/        Logic and integration tests
tests/components/   Component tests
tests/playwright/   Browser tests against a running application at APP_URL (Playwright; Vitest skips it)
```

**Never put a test beside the source it covers.** Name files `*.test.ts` or `*.test.tsx`.

`vitest.config.ts` discovers `tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` automatically. Theme token tests compile the real CSS; browser checks still need to verify computed styles, typography, spacing and focus.

Templates ship their tests into generated applications. Keep them runnable from the application root after scaffolding: read application identity from `package.json`, resolve application paths relative to the test file, and import dependencies through their published package exports. Do not depend on a monorepo checkout, a fixed template directory name, or a particular pnpm store layout. evidence.observation: 客户端路由注册会拼接父子路径、检查缺失 path、保留根路径和保留路由，表明嵌套路由由应用在 routes.ts 声明并由父页渲染 Outlet。
child-routes 指引写明子路由放入父路由 children，且父页面必须自己放置 <Outlet />；RouteChildPage、RouteDialog、RouteDrawer 都不会自动插入。
evidence.excerpt:
- **Child routes go in the parent route's `children`**, declared in `client/routes.ts`, not in page component files.
- A child route's `path` is relative to its parent and is appended to the parent's path. A leading `/` is stripped before joining, so `new` and `/new` behave the same; this handbook writes the form without `/`.
- **The parent page must place `<Outlet />` itself**, where the child content should appear. Pages do not insert an Outlet automatically, and neither do `RouteChildPage`, `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`; only a plain navigation group gets its Outlet from the route renderer.
- **A child route that is a page of its own returns `RouteChildPage`.** Only tab content renders inline. A child route with a `PageContainer` of its own — a record's page, a form too long for a dialog, an import page — wraps it in `RouteChildPage` ([section 5](#5-covering-child-pages-routechildpage)). Returned bare, it renders at the parent's `Outlet`, below everything the parent shows, and the user has to scroll past the parent page to find it. A page that returns a bare `PageContainer` belongs on a top-level route instead.
- Child routes inherit the entry route's `auth` and cannot change it, and follow the `authz` inheritance rules in [section 4 of `page.md`](page.md#4-authz-page-authorization): a child page renders only after the parent page's check passes.
- Link to a child route with a relative path and keep the query string ([section 2.2 of `overlay.md`](overlay.md#22-place-the-outlet-in-the-parent-page)). A relative path resolves against the route that renders the link, not the URL on screen ([section 2 of `page.md`](page.md#2-the-page-component)).
- Route declarations have no `index` field. Do not invent an index route, and do not register a child route at the parent's own path; when "opening the parent URL shows a particular child page" is needed, use the redirect in [section 4](#4-page-tabs).

evidence.observation: API 指引要求从 @nocobase/app-client 使用 useApiClient/apiClientToken/ApiClientError，禁止自建 client、fetch/axios 或硬编码 /api。
evidence.excerpt:
- **Do not** create your own client, do not use `fetch` or axios, do not hard-code `/api`, and do not build endpoint URLs from `location`. The client's base URL (the configuration key `api.baseURL`, by default `resolveAppUrl('/api')`) already includes the deployment base path (for example `/main`).
- For a URL served by the application, such as an API download `href`, an API-backed image or a page link, use `resolveAppUrl('/api/…')` from `@nocobase/app-client`, which adds the runtime deployment base path. Keep runtime-generated resources on this helper.
- For a static file shipped in the frontend build, use `resolveAssetUrl('/assets/logo.png')` from `@nocobase/app-client`. Paths are relative to the client output root (`dist/client/assets/logo.png` in this example), with or without a leading slash. The helper uses Vite's absolute HTTP(S) `base` when configured, and otherwise falls back to `resolveAppUrl`; existing absolute, protocol-relative, data and blob URLs are preserved. The templates set `base` from `CDN_BASE_URL` during the build, and Vite writes it into the client code as `import.meta.env.BASE_URL`. Changing CDN settings requires rebuilding and uploading the matching files. Business code should call the helper rather than read the build variable itself.
- Import `useApiClient`, `apiClientToken`, the `ApiClient` type and `ApiClientError` from `@nocobase/app-client`. That way the application and plugins share one runtime and one error class, which is what makes `instanceof ApiClientError` reliable.

nocobase-db Skill 规定迁移默认用 builder/query，repository 仅用于 query 难以正确表达的写入，并提醒 repository 是在押注迁移自身未声明的 Collection 形状。
evidence.excerpt:
| Context   | Tools                            | Default for data |
| --------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Migration | `builder`, `query`, `repository` | `query`          |
| Seed      | `repository`, `query`            | `repository`     |

A migration changes structure, so `builder` and `query` are its tools and `repository` is reserved for the writes `query` would get wrong: cross-dialect field encoding and decoding, Collection-level naming overrides, and relation writes including the junction rows behind a `belongsToMany`. **Anything `query` expresses correctly stays on `query`.** A seed changes no structure and writes installation data in Collection terms, so `repository` is its normal tool and `query` covers what that cannot express, such as reading a physical table backing no Collection.

This does not loosen the self-contained rule. `repository(name)` resolves the Collection from the database itself — the metadata a previous `builder` operation wrote — which is why it is available at all; importing or iterating the application's own collection definitions from a migration stays forbidden. But a migration using it is betting on a shape it did not declare in its own body, so three constraints follow:

- Say in a comment why `query` was not enough. Nothing static can check this, and the comment is what separates a considered use from a reflex.
- Do not use it in `down`. By the time a rollback runs, the Collection has moved past what `up` left behind, possibly several migrations past.
- Do not use it to walk a table. Selecting every row and updating each one through a Repository is the shape to avoid; a set-based `query` statement is both correct and bounded.
